a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs 2 storm-free rounds before anyone takes, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both end up short, so please wait or operate in round 1. After that, I'll operate every round so we can rebuild cells for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said in my opening message. Our messages crossed, so I know you hadn't seen mine when you wrote yours. From now on I'll operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
